limitations: API-07 exposes authorized redacted JSON and a keyed digest, not raw artifact bytes, a download URL, a content-type discriminator, or a receipt-detail endpoint. WEB-06 therefore offers no raw download and renders unknown presentation types as structured or escaped data.

API-07 exposes a step's idempotency-support classification and an external action's receipt identity/status, but never its protected idempotency key or connector result metadata. The UI labels those absences instead of inventing values or links.

Advisory and Markdown presentation use a closed catalog template/schema mapping because the artifact response has no advisory or presentation discriminator. Arbitrary payload fields cannot opt themselves into Markdown or advisory treatment.

The browser gate uses the production Vite application and deterministic same-origin API-07 run, timeline, artifact-list, and artifact-detail fixtures. It does not exercise a live worker, provider, connector, raw receipt store, or non-loopback service.

WEB-07 owns narrow list/tree fallback and WEB-08 owns exhaustive accessibility, contrast, reduced-motion, and axe acceptance. WEB-06 covers semantic headings, textual states, keyboard artifact navigation, focus visibility inherited from the shell, and bounded polling behavior.
